evidence: A satisfying settlement authorizes the system, sets purges to 300 liters every 30 cycles, reserves 6 hours, sets pH to 7.13–7.47, requires first-90-seconds sampling and wastewater logging, records separate engineering-signoff and regulator-note commitments, and uses PF1 and PF2 as revealed justification facts. A settlement missing PF2 would plausibly fail C4, C5, C6, and P1.
